response.sql:
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT batting_hand,
       appearance_count,
       1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
       1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS count_over_average
FROM counts;

assumptions.assumption: Missing batting-hand values are retained as their own group and included when calculating the total and average across batting-hand groups.
